item.title: Rep. Riley Moore Says Nixon Was Framed and Forced Out
item.description: Rep. Riley Moore gave a revisionist account of Watergate on Thursday, speaking at the Richard Nixon Foundation's Grand Strategy Summit.

item.title: Iraq Warns of Terror Threat From Syria After US Withdrawal
item.description: Iraq's foreign minister warned that ISIS fighters could cross from Syria as Baghdad ready its forces one day after the US military withdrawal.

item.title: 128 GOP Lawmakers Seek Federal Probe of Planned Parenthood Funding
item.description: A group of 128 Republican lawmakers is asking the HHS Inspector General to review Planned Parenthood's federal funding for possible fraud or abuse.

item.title: House GOP's Four-Week Plan to Preserve Its Majority
item.description: House GOP Chairwoman Lisa McClain outlined four key topics Republicans plan to emphasize in the final weeks before the November midterms.
